تفتقدون (form VIII)
# تَفْتَقِدُونَ (taftaqidūna) /taf.ta.qi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# تُفْتَقَدُونَ (tuftaqadūna) /tuf.ta.qa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
